Name: Average biting rate per female mosquito
Description: Average number of bites delivered by a female mosquito per unit time.
Unit: bites per mosquito per unit time

Name: Fraction of bites on humans
Description: Percentage of bites that are on humans rather than alternative hosts.

Name: Number of infectious bites delivered per vector per day
Description: Transmission-related biting parameter used in the model equations and tables.
Unit: infectious bites per vector per day

Name: Human incubation time
Description: Average incubation period in humans.

Name: Vector incubation time
Description: Average incubation period in vectors.

Name: Recovery time
Description: Average infectious period reciprocal / recovery time for humans.

Name: Number of eggs laid per female mosquito per unit time
Description: Egg production rate of adult female mosquitoes.
Unit: eggs per female mosquito per unit time

Name: Egg development time
Description: Reciprocal of egg development rate.

Name: Egg mortality
Description: Mortality rate of eggs.

Name: Larval development time
Description: Reciprocal of larval development rate.

Name: Larval mortality
Description: Mortality rate of larvae.

Name: Pupal development time
Description: Reciprocal of pupal development rate.

Name: Pupal mortality
Description: Mortality rate of pupae.

Name: Adult mortality
Description: Mortality rate of adult female vectors.

Name: Female adult percentage
Description: Fraction of adult vectors that are female.

Name: Human population growth rate
Description: Logistic growth rate of the human population.

Name: Human carrying capacity
Description: Carrying capacity for the human population.

Name: Larval carrying capacity
Description: Carrying capacity for larvae.

Name: Larvae mortality rate due to limited carrying capacity
Description: Density-dependent mortality term for larvae.

Name: Alternative hosts
Description: Number of non-human alternative hosts in the environment.
